question: What happens to an order when it gets cancelled?
answer: A `DELETE` request to `/api/orders/:id` reaches a handler that calls `cancelOrder` with the numeric path id and returns the result as JSON [src/routes/orders.ts:14-21]. `cancelOrder` only logs `cancelling via prisma.order.delete(...)`, then performs `prisma.order.update` on that id to set its `status` to `PENDING`, so the record is updated rather than deleted [src/services/orders.ts:24-27]. The `status` field holds an `OrderStatus` enum whose values are `PENDING`, `PAID`, and `SHIPPED` [prisma/schema.prisma:13-17].
